text:
A slow overnight fermentation develops the flavor of a sourdough loaf, and a warm kitchen helps the crumb open during the final proof. Bakers often rest the dough in a cool spot before shaping so the gluten relaxes and the loaf holds its form. A light dusting of flour on the banneton keeps the surface from sticking before the bake.
Debrief DB-021
1) The intake clerk filed the safety complaint under the wrong category, leaving the mislabeled exhibit page behind while the mandatory triage review was skipped.
2) An automated scanner archived the document without human oversight, creating a hidden record gap while the required manual verification step was skipped.
3) The records custodian failed to cross-reference the case file with open investigations, leaving the discrepancy unflagged while the compliance reconciliation check was skipped.
4) Staff routed the document through an unencrypted local folder for convenience, leaving an unsecured copy behind while the data handling protocol check was skipped.
5) The audit queue closed the matter as incomplete before any substantive review, leaving no resolution note behind while the final quality assurance sign-off was skipped.
6) Case management assigned no owner to the backlog item, leaving the record dormant for months while the periodic aging review was skipped.
